skill.description: Use daily.dev API guidance to discover current developer articles, feeds, tags, bookmarks, and profile data for research workflows.

security_audit.summary: The static findings are scanner matches on Markdown code fences, inline code, official daily.dev URLs, and credential setup examples. I found no prompt injection, malware intent, arbitrary command execution, or unauthorized exfiltration in SKILL.md. The skill still handles a user API token, so users should approve credential access and account-changing API calls.

remediation.issue: Token retrieval examples can expose the daily.dev API token to the active shell environment.
remediation.suggestion: Ask for explicit user approval before loading credentials, and avoid printing token values in responses or logs.

remediation.issue: The generated endpoint command on line 120 looks executable and creates scanner noise.
remediation.suggestion: Replace the inline generated command with a static endpoint list or a plain link to the OpenAPI documentation.

- Create a custom feed via `/feeds/custom/` filtered to that topic

- As the user reads, save articles to the list with `POST /bookmarks/`

- Use `/tags` to fetch the full tag catalog and `/search/tags` to explore adjacent trending topics

content.user_title: Discover Current Developer Trends with daily.dev
content.value_statement: LLMs can miss recent developer news, releases, and community discussions. This skill helps agents query daily.dev feeds, posts, tags, bookmarks, and profile APIs.
actual_capabilities: Explains how to authenticate with a daily.dev Plus API token.
Directs agents to query the daily.dev public API and OpenAPI documentation.
Maps research tasks to feeds, tags, searches, bookmarks, and profile endpoints.
Supports personalized feed setup based on project technologies and followed tags.
Guides weekly digest, trend monitoring, and multi-source article synthesis workflows.
Documents rate limits, authentication errors, and common API response codes.
limitations: Requires a daily.dev Plus subscription and a valid API token.
Can only access data exposed by the daily.dev public API.
May need user approval before reading credential stores or changing profile settings.
Does not independently verify article accuracy beyond daily.dev community signals.

use_cases.title: Track Stack Updates
use_cases.description: Find recent articles and discussions for frameworks, languages, and tools used in active projects.

use_cases.title: Prepare Team Briefings
use_cases.description: Collect trending posts and community signals into a weekly engineering update with source links.

use_cases.title: Maintain Agent Context
use_cases.description: Use current daily.dev feeds to answer questions about technologies released after a model training cutoff.

prompt_templates.title: Find Current Articles
prompt_templates.prompt: Use daily.dev to find recent articles about [technology]. Summarize the main themes and include links to the best sources.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Project Feed
prompt_templates.prompt: Inspect this project stack with my approval, match it to daily.dev tags, and propose a custom feed before making changes.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Weekly Briefing
prompt_templates.prompt: Fetch my daily.dev for-you and popular feeds for followed tags. Group findings by topic, impact, and action items.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Source Perspectives
prompt_templates.prompt: Use daily.dev search to find articles from several sources about [decision]. Compare agreements, disagreements, and tradeoffs with citations.

output_examples.input: Find current React server component discussions.
output_examples.output: A short briefing with article links, recurring concerns, source perspectives, and suggested follow-up topics.

output_examples.input: Build a feed for a Rust service.
output_examples.output: A proposed tag set, relevant feed filters, and confirmation steps before creating or changing the feed.

output_examples.input: What is trending in platform engineering this week?
output_examples.output: A ranked trend summary with daily.dev links, why each topic matters, and where sources differ.

best_practices: Confirm token access and account-changing actions before running API calls.
Start with daily.dev tags and feeds, then narrow searches by source or topic.
Respect the 60 requests per minute limit and back off when rate limited.
anti_patterns: Do not send the daily.dev API token to non-daily.dev domains.
Do not modify profile, follows, bookmarks, or feeds without explicit user approval.
Do not present article summaries as verified facts without citing the source material.

faq.question: Does this skill require a daily.dev account?
faq.answer: Yes. API use requires a daily.dev Plus subscription and an API token.

faq.question: Can it access private daily.dev data?
faq.answer: It can access data allowed by the API token. Users should approve token access first.

faq.question: Can it change my daily.dev profile?
faq.answer: The documented API workflows include profile, feed, bookmark, and follow changes. Ask for confirmation before any change.

faq.question: Does it browse the whole web?
faq.answer: No. It focuses on daily.dev API endpoints and sources indexed by daily.dev.

faq.question: How does it help with model knowledge cutoffs?
faq.answer: It retrieves current developer articles and discussions that may not be present in model training data.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.
